entries.decision: main is the only durable installation/version/publication truth; temporary PR branches are review-only and stale non-main refs may not carry alternate trees or versions.
Video is exactly one native modalities checkbox on a concrete owned Ark/Agent Plan model card. Source-level selectors/master switches and shared-schema foreign-visible fallbacks are forbidden.
Owned Volcengine cards preserve AstrBot custom_extra_body and expose typed Video Quality, thinking and sampling/output/penalty rows; visibility and persistence are part of release correctness.

Compile/import/no-conflict/unit-only evidence cannot publish a model-card UI release. The exact candidate must pass visible checkbox click, save/reopen, process restart, foreign isolation and uninstall cleanup on the current host matrix.
Provider/model identity and transient feedback are scoped evidence, not permanent global model-capability truth. Missing feedback is not false.
AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, retry and fallback. The plugin owns only Volcengine-specific protocol/media adaptation and its scoped model-card request-field projection.
